```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#### Setup
# Load packages
library(blackmarbler)
library(geodata)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(lubridate)

#### Define NASA bearer token
bearer <- get_nasa_token(
    username = Sys.getenv("NASA_USERNAME"),
    password = Sys.getenv("NASA_PASSWORD")
)

### ROI
# Define region of interest (roi). The roi must be (1) an sf polygon and (2)
# in the WGS84 (epsg:4326) coordinate reference system. Here, we use the
# getData function to load a polygon of Ghana
roi_sf <- gadm(country = "UGA", level=1, path = tempdir()) 
```

## Usage

See <https://worldbank.github.io/blackmarbler/#usage>

```{r}
# Force BlackMarbler to use wget for downloading (needed on Windows)
Sys.setenv(LAADS_DOWNLOAD_METHOD = "wget")

# Check that the LAADS download method is set correctly (should return "wget")
Sys.getenv()[grep("LAADS", names(Sys.getenv()))]

# Optional: verify that wget is installed and accessible from the system PATH
# system("wget --version")
```

```{r}
# Create a stable folder for downloaded HDF5 files
h5_folder <- file.path(getwd(), "blackmarble_h5")
dir.create(h5_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Download VIIRS Black Marble raster
r_oct2021 <- bm_raster(
  roi_sf = roi_sf,
  product_id = "VNP46A3",   # Monthly product
  date = "2021-10-01",
  bearer = bearer,
  download_method = "wget",
  h5_dir = h5_folder,      
  quiet = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Check that data was successfully downloaded
if (!is.null(r_oct2021) && nlyr(r_oct2021) > 0) {
  
  # Create output directory for final rasters
  output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs")
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Save as GeoTIFF
  writeRaster(
    r_oct2021,
    filename = file.path(output_dir, "ntl_2021_10.tif"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  
  # Save also as R object
  saveRDS(
    r_oct2021,
    file.path(output_dir, "ntl_2021_10.Rds")
  )
  
  cat("Download and save completed successfully.\n")
  
} else {
  
  cat("Download failed: raster object is empty.\n")
}
```

```{r}
r_oct2021 <- readRDS(file.path(getwd(), "bm_outputs", "ntl_2021_10.Rds"))
```

### Map of nighttime lights

```{r}
#### Prep data
r <- r_oct2021 |> terra::mask(roi_sf)

## Distribution is skewed, so log
r[] <- log(r[] + 1)

##### Map
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black",
                       mid = "yellow",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 4.5,
                       na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "Nighttime Lights: October 2021") +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  legend.position = "none")
```
